name: Card
looksLike: box with a picture title and description
small bordered block with a heading and a link
definition: A container that groups related information about one item, often with a title, image, description, or action.

notConfusedWith.difference: Appears over the page and blocks interaction; a card stays in the page layout.

prompts.short: Add a card grouping a title and description with a clear action link.
prompts.detailed: Add a responsive card with a semantic heading, description, and descriptive action link. Keep the heading order logical, avoid nesting interactive controls inside links, and provide a visible focus ring and 44px link target.
